name: open-source-credits
title: Open source credits
description: The libraries your product ships, with version and licence, searchable and linked to each full licence text in a dialog.
docs: Pass packages (a name, version, SPDX license and optional repository) and licenseTexts keyed by SPDX id. Packages are grouped by licence family, so BSD-2-Clause and BSD-3-Clause sit together, with a count for each, and sorted by name within a licence. A licence with a text opens it in a dialog with a button that copies it, for a notice file; a browser that refuses to copy gets the text selected instead. The dialog joins the line breaks of hand-wrapped paragraphs so the text reads on a phone; the button copies it exactly as you supplied it. A licence without a text is shown as plain words, an empty licence reads Unknown, and a dual licence such as MIT OR Apache-2.0 opens either text. The search field filters by package name and announces how many are left; searchable={false} drops it for a short list. licenseFamily and licenseParts are exported from the licenses file. Supply the real text of each licence: it carries each project's own copyright line. Pass labels to translate the fixed words.
